preregistered_decision_rule.supportive_if: The third lifecycle is technically resolved, mark-consistent, and net PnL after official funding is greater than $12.093905. This makes the three-path forward sample positive after removing its largest winner.
preregistered_decision_rule.not_supportive_if: The third lifecycle is at or below $12.093905 after funding, technically unresolved, or inconsistent with exact mark-stop timing.
preregistered_decision_rule.selection_effect: Supportive evidence permits an explicit approval request for a bounded live-research replacement; it does not establish durable profitability or authorize deployment automatically.

success_metrics: Positive three-path forward net after exact costs and official funding.
Positive three-path net after removing the largest winner.
Zero wrong-side, non-HYPE, duplicate, stale, unprotected, or identity-mismatched actions.
At $5,000 notional, complete sampled visible depth with incremental entry impact no worse than 5 bps versus the $1,250 tier.
failure_or_rollback_triggers: Technical evidence failure blocks the economic decision. A later approved live route returns to report-only at a separately approved flat/order-free boundary after any unprotected exposure, wrong-side/non-HYPE action, exit-plan mismatch, or a predeclared compatible live window that is net negative after costs.
confidence_level: High for entry identity, same-bar baseline divergence, HYPE-only scope, and sampled $5,000 entry capacity; low-to-medium for absolute profitability until the third path resolves; no claim of durable edge from N=3.
